resolution.question: Ashvale University's annual-fund caller will phone alumna Dr. Renata Sousa, who has never donated, with a first-time ask. Will Renata make any pledge by the end of the month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Renata made a pledge (verbally committed to donate a specific amount) to the caller before 2026-10-31T21:00:00-03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
